data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 claims O(n^3) time 'polynomial in n alone,' but its described algorithm computes 'optimal coin counts via dynamic programming' for amounts in the intervals [c_i, c_{i-1}+c_i]. Building a DP table for optimal coin counts up to amount c_{i-1}+c_i requires time proportional to that magnitude — at least Omega(c_{i-1}+c_i) per interval — which depends on coin magnitudes, not on n alone. The amounts tested can be as large as c_1+c_2, so the overall running time of the described method is pseudo-polynomial, directly contradicting the target's own claim of a bound polynomial in n alone. The internal inconsistency between the stated complexity and the described algorithm is a genuine fault against requirement 3.
